deviations.what: c7 S4 *A/C statement*: the account name in the header is cut short. The captures now push S4 over a base route as production does (ledger_routes.dart pushes it on the root navigator), so the app bar draws its leading back button, and with 'Download / Share' and ••• beside it the title gets ~81 px on iOS 390 and ~51 px on Android 360: 'Sunil D…' and 'Ramesh…' (S4__default, S4__opening-not-set), 'Suni…' and 'Ra…' (__android360). The frame gives the name the full width of its own line ('Sunil Dairy', 'Ramesh Kumar') with only the ⋮ beside the chevron
deviations.reason: [screen] defect at default size — the name of the account is the one thing this header must say, and 07 §1 / 13 §8 forbid clipping it. The cure is the frame's tall header (name on its own line, export off the title row) or moving 'Download / Share' into the ••• menu; s4_account_statement_screen.dart is the ledger lane's, not this audit's
deviations.authority: 07 §1 🔒 / 13 §8 (text never cut); ADR 2026-10-05 §1; ledger_routes.dart (S4 pushed on the root navigator)

deviations.what: c7 S4 *A/C statement*: the app lays the statement out in the three professional columns — a 'Dr  Cr  Balance' header, then per row a Dr figure, a Cr figure and the running balance with its side ('₹420  ₹420 Cr', '₹500 … ₹450 Cr'), with 'Opening balance b/f · 01 Apr 2026  ₹0' first and 'Closing balance c/f · 07 Sep 2026  ₹870 Cr' last; the frame draws a grouped listing — one arrowed figure per row ('↑ ₹420' red, '↓ ₹2,000' green), the running balance in the date band ('Balance ₹1,370 Cr'), no opening row, and the closing pinned in a band above the action bar ('Closing 30 Aug 2026  ₹1,370 Cr')
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] — 07 §6 🔒 rules the on-screen statement as the traditional three columns Dr | Cr | Balance with dated Opening b/f and Closing c/f. ⚠️ SPEC (open): 13 §3.2 row S4 reads 'grouped listing; professional columns in export', which agrees with the frame; 07 owns screens (CLAUDE.md § Precedence 2b), so the app keeps the columns until the owner rules
deviations.authority: 07 §6 🔒 (three columns, Opening b/f, Closing c/f — owner rule); ADR 2026-10-10b §4 🔒 (A/C statement shows Dr/Cr plainly); CLAUDE.md § Precedence
